name: Texas Kings Textile
old_description: At Texas Kings Textile we specialize in sourcing the best materials from known institutional, credential rag suppliers as well as premium Stock lots. Over the last 10 years, we have grown to be in a leading position in textile recycling industry.
about:
Texas Kings Textile operates from a warehouse at 7405 Cayuga Street in Houston, Texas. The company has spent roughly a decade building a position in the textile recycling sector, sourcing used clothing and wiping rags from institutional suppliers and premium stock lots. No founding year or founders are disclosed.

The business focuses on procuring, sorting, and grading mixed rags, children’s sweats, children’s clothing, and vintage apparel. Experienced sorters and graders evaluate incoming material against current fashion trends and vintage demand. The operation runs out of a single Houston warehouse; no facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Texas Kings Textile serves an international buyer network spanning Latin America, Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. Named destinations include Bolivia, Chile, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Liberia, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Zambia, Sharjah, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia, Guinea, Cameroon, Nigeria, Malawi, Senegal, Mali, and Jordan. The customer base consists of wholesale buyers and recyclers in those regions.

The company emphasizes its sorters’ familiarity with fashion trends and vintage markets as a differentiator, along with established supply relationships with credentialed rag suppliers. It positions itself as a link between North American textile waste streams and overseas reuse markets.
